programmes.d: Tom and his daughter Kia are on the mighty Salmon River, doing some underwater metal detecting, looking for gold nuggets.
Tom and his daughter Kia are on the Oregon trail, hunting for the legendary Blue Bucket Mine.
Tom and his son Kael are underneath a huge glacier, metal detecting for gold nuggets.
Tom and his daughter Kia are re-tracing old footsteps by paying a visit to the old Pine Log property in California.
Tom and his daughter Kia are sluicing in Eastern Oregon, looking for gold.
Tom and his son Kael are dredging in Anchorage, trying to find some gold for Cindy's birthday gift.
With the drought in California, Tom and his daughter Kia sail down the Stanislaus River, in search of gold that would otherwise be too deep to find underwater.
Tom and Kia are out in the desert exploring old mine shafts.
Tom and Kia are out metal detecting in the desert looking for the lost Peg-Leg treasure.
It's summertime in Alaska so Tom and Kia are making the most of the twenty-four hours of daylight.
It's a big year for the Cripple River mining camp in Nome Alaska. The crew is extremely busy and the participants are already finding some of the biggest gold in recent history.
Tom's been dredging a spot on Arctic creek for the past couple years. Now is the time he and Kia are gonna open the hole up in hopes of finding some serious gold.
A potential Electra plane purchase in Coventry, England has Joe showing Mikey the ropes of international business.
While training pilots for the upcoming fire season, chief pilot Arnie makes an unexpected announcement.

Joe hires an outsider to whip Buffalo into shape – starting with Mikey. Gord and Sean’s DC-3 delivery to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

Buffalo gets into the stunt flying business, re-enacting a famous WWII bombing raid with a DC-4. A hole in the C-46’s exhaust system forces Devan to decide whether or not to shut down an engine mid-flight.

Frustrated with the constant drama at Buffalo, Chuck quits. Joe clashes with the maintenance department when a series of delays puts the important sale of a Canso aircraft in jeopardy. Mikey goes on an ATV hunting trip.
Devan, Ian and Jimmy deal with a hydraulic fluid leak in the C-46 on the valley run, which forces Jimmy to crawl into the "hell hole" and crank down the landing gear by hand.
Marc drives a load of 20 something's to the "Big Easy" for Mardi Gras, on a run that proves to be anything but easy.
Roy books a complicated Linotype machine, and things get really complicated.
Roy lands a wild load of giant, murderous Animatronic Hillbillies, and he almost turns into one himself.
With hopes of upping his game, Jarrett joins Marc to learn the ropes on a big rig run.
Marc is a bit outnumbered when he transports 4 million angry bees, and turns it into a battle of attrition.
Jarrett seemingly faces the seven plagues and more when he hauls a pedal pub and a side load of sod.
Jarrett's brush with Rock n' Roll fame takes a turn for the worse when he scrambles to deliver their chicken car on time.
After challenging Chris that girls can do anything a guy can, Robbie takes over a very "macho" shipment.
Jennifer takes on a cross-country load of live bugs that require a little more love and attention than she might be willing to give.
Fate brings Roy back to Austin, Texas--this time to haul a very big (and very odd) sculpture from a peace-loving art collective.
Chris and Robbie awkwardly go where no transporter has gone before when a run brings them in contact with a Star Trek convention and its alien life forms.
Sparks fly when Roy battles with two customers while transporting their shipments to a Renaissance Faire...
Mike helps turn 40 dump trucks of dirt into a Monster Jam track at Harris Bradley Arena in Milwaukee, then test drives the legendary Max D monster truck.
Mike meets carpenters Adam Dick and Dustin Taylor, who used their love of chocolate and old, second-hand equipment to turn their lumberyard into a chocolate factory.
Mike attends the PBR in Chicago, Illinois, to train and work as a bull fighter.
Mike attends the SkillsUSA National Competition in Kansas City, Missouri, and tries his hand at welding, cake decorating, and broadcasting. Spoiler Alert: He’s not good!
Mike visits the Two-Bit Circus in Los Angeles, California, where disruptive innovators have added an A to STEM to make it STEAM—Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math.
Mike meets the man who is pulling millions of pounds of trash from America’s waterways.
In this two-episode segment, Mike and his crew take you deep inside the workings of the largest ship in the US Navy, the USS John Stennis.
From the mess hall to the flight deck, Mike does every job on the ship, and along the way learns the history of these floating cities.

Region 7 wardens converge upon the Intake fishing access site on the Yellowstone River as the annual paddlefish migration is in full swing. Watch anglers snag paddlefish and Wardens snag illegal anglers!

The Tongue River Reservoir State Park in south-central Montana is a popular summer destination for recreationists and fishermen, and Warden Mike Krings has his hands full keeping peace among the night crowd.

Wardens in Region 5 work their way up the Yellowstone River with a jet boat checking fly fishing outfitters while coming across a boat accident along the way. Then it's over to Region 1 for firearms training.

With Pronghorn antelope populations dwindling, Wardens of Region 7 run a decoy sting the day before the season begins but the real problem arises with trespassing on the opener. Then Region 4 Warden Bryan Golie has a potential poaching call.

The Upper Missouri River is a blue-ribbon trout fishery & popular rafting destination. The Cascade district in Region 4 has its share of excitement with the mysterious camper parked on private land. Then over to Region 7 for some water safety checks.

Region 2 wardens are responding to a Tip Mont call with multiple elk down in grizzly country. Upon arrival, one elk & the suspect are missing. In the meantime, wardens in Region 7 have shots fired during a decoy sting.

When your job is protecting our most precious natural resources in some of the nation's most remote areas, there is rarely a dull moment. Wardens chronicles the lives of Conservation Officers in America.

In the shadows of the crazy mountains, the Yellowstone River becomes a rainbow of color during the annual boat float weekend. With jet boats, the Wardens are prepared for a crazy weekend of protecting the river and assisting the crazed rafters.
This week our Wardens receive a Tip-Mont call about a few illegally taken elk and pursue the the suspects.
This week our Wardens are in Montana monitoring the rivers while people paddlefish and we also try and eliminate a pesky bear from one man's property.
